Runbook: Operations & Incidents

Routine operations and incident response — a reference guide for the on-call administrator

Ops Guide — 4 of 6

Routine Operations

Commands for day-to-day monitoring and platform management. All commands are executed remotely via SSH.

Container Statusssh root@lexiro.io "docker compose ps"
API Logs (last 100 lines)ssh root@lexiro.io "docker compose logs -f api --tail 100"
Worker Logsssh root@lexiro.io "docker compose logs -f worker --tail 100"
Health Checkssh root@lexiro.io "curl -sf http://localhost:8000/health && echo OK || echo FAIL"
Full Dependency Checkssh root@lexiro.io "curl -s http://localhost:8000/ready | python3 -m json.tool"
Restart Servicessh root@lexiro.io "cd /opt/lexiro && docker compose restart api"
Restart Entire Stackssh root@lexiro.io "cd /opt/lexiro && docker compose up -d api worker beat"
Docker Cleanupssh root@lexiro.io "docker system prune -f"
Disk Spacessh root@lexiro.io "df -h && docker system df"
Check Setting in Containerssh root@lexiro.io "docker exec lexiro-worker-1 python -c 'from app.config import settings; print(settings.app_env)'"

Incidents

Standard incident cards with diagnostics, resolution, and verification. Use as a checklist during incident response.

API Not Responding
Critical
Symptom
curl http://localhost:8000/health does not return 200. Users see 502/503.
Diagnostics
Check container status and logs:
Statusdocker compose ps
API logsdocker compose logs api --tail 50
Diskdf -h
Resolution
Restart the service. If the image is corrupted — rebuild:
Restartdocker compose restart api
Rebuilddocker compose build api && docker compose up -d api worker beat
Verification
Checkcurl http://localhost:8000/ready
Should return JSON with statuses of all dependencies.
High Error Rate (5xx)
Critical
Symptom
Grafana alert "High Error Rate". Users are receiving errors.
Diagnostics
Search for errors in logs and check Gemini API quota:
LogQL{container="/lexiro-api-1"} | json | level="error"
Check Gemini API quota in Google Cloud Console.
Resolution
If Gemini quota — wait for reset or rotate the key. If a code bug — rollback:
Rollbackgit checkout HEAD~1
Rebuilddocker compose build api && docker compose up -d api worker beat
Verification
Monitor error rate in Grafana for 5 minutes. Ensure 5xx has dropped to normal levels.
DB Pool Saturation
Warning
Symptom
Grafana alert "DB Pool Saturation". Slow API responses.
Diagnostics
Check active connection count:
Connectionsdocker exec lexiro-postgres-1 psql -U lexiro -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity;"
Resolution
Reset the connection pool. If recurring — look for long-running queries:
Restartdocker compose restart api
Long queriesSELECT pid, now() - query_start AS duration, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' ORDER BY duration DESC;
Verification
Checkcurl http://localhost:8000/ready
Check pg status in the response.
MinIO Unavailable
Critical
Symptom
Grafana alert "MinIO Unhealthy" or "S3 Write Failures". File uploads are failing.
Diagnostics
Check container status, logs, and disk:
Statusdocker compose ps minio
Logsdocker compose logs minio --tail 50
Diskdf -h
Resolution
Restart MinIO. If the disk is full — clean up:
Restartdocker compose restart minio
Cleanupdocker system prune -f
Verification
Checkcurl http://localhost:8000/ready
Check s3 status in the response.
Celery Queue Growing
Warning
Symptom
Grafana "Queue Monitor" shows growing pending tasks.
Diagnostics
Look for errors and stuck tasks:
Worker logsdocker compose logs worker --tail 50
Resolution
Restart the worker. If a task is stuck — inspect:
Restartdocker compose restart worker
Inspectdocker exec lexiro-worker-1 celery -A app.celery_app inspect active
Verification
Monitor queue depth in Grafana. Pending tasks should be decreasing.
SSL Certificate Expired
Critical
Symptom
Browser shows a certificate error. HTTPS is not working.
Diagnostics
Check certificate dates:
Datesopenssl s_client -connect lexiro.io:443 -servername lexiro.io 2>/dev/null | openssl x509 -noout -dates
Resolution
Update certificate files in /etc/nginx/ssl/ and reload Nginx:
Reloadnginx -t && nginx -s reload
Verification
Open the site in a browser — the padlock should be green. Verify dates with the command above.
Disk Full
Warning
Symptom
Services are crashing. Logs show: "no space left on device".
Diagnostics
Find what is consuming space:
Overviewdf -h
Dockerdocker system df
Detailsdu -sh /var/lib/docker/*
Resolution
Remove unused images. Clean up logs. Expand disk if necessary:
Cleanupdocker system prune -f
Verification
Spacedf -h
Containersdocker compose ps
Free space has increased. All containers are healthy.

Escalation

Incident
Resolvable in 15 min?
Yes
Standard steps
No
User data affected?
Yes
Security + DevOps Lead
No
DevOps Lead

Escalate the incident if:

• The problem is not resolved by the standard steps from the card within 15 minutes.
• The incident affects user data (lost documents, database corruption).
• A database migration rollback or backup restoration is required.
• A secret leak has occurred (API keys, JWT secret in logs or public access).
• The server is unreachable via SSH (hosting-level issue).

When escalating, provide: symptom description, start time, steps taken, current service status (docker compose ps), latest error logs.
